summary: Aerolink advertises $5 in one-time testing credits for eligible new accounts after verification and abuse checks. Valid for 30 days; no recurring free plan. The original one-week Starter trial is no longer on the pricing page.
claim_steps: Generate an API key from the dashboard and point your client at the Aerolink base URL.
Check eligibility for the $5 testing credit in the account dashboard; the credit is valid for 30 days.
